recommendations.issue: Long wait times and service delays caused by understaffing and kitchen bottlenecks during peak hours.
recommendations.action: Adjust staff scheduling to increase front-of-house and back-of-house coverage during peak hours, and implement a kitchen display system (KDS) to streamline order flow and track preparation bottlenecks.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in customer wait times, faster table turnover, and decreased staff stress.

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality and taste due to rushed preparation during busy services.
recommendations.action: Standardize recipe cards and portion guides at all prep and cooking stations, and designate a dedicated expediter during peak shifts to ensure every dish meets quality standards before leaving the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved food consistency, fewer remakes, and higher customer satisfaction regarding taste.

recommendations.issue: Staff attitude and service quality issues driven by high stress and employee burnout.
recommendations.action: Introduce a monthly staff training program focusing on guest communication and de-escalation, and implement regular shift check-ins to monitor workload and improve morale.
recommendations.expected_impact: Friendlier customer service interactions, lower employee turnover, and a more positive working environment.

recommendations.issue: Customer discontent regarding high pricing and perceived poor value relative to portion size and quality.
recommendations.action: Conduct a menu engineering review to audit portion sizes and ingredient costs, offering targeted value bundles or tweaking descriptions to better align perceived value with menu prices.
recommendations.expected_impact: Better alignment between price and customer expectations, leading to reduced complaints about value.
